articles.title: GHSA: Docling: Unbounded table rowspan/colspan in HTML, JATS, ODS and BoxNote backends causes CPU/memory exhaustion
articles.summary:
### Summary

The HTML, JATS, ODS (OpenDocument spreadsheet) and BoxNote backends accept table `rowspan` / `colspan` values without an upper bound. A few bytes of input, such as `<td rowspan="100000000">`, make docling run loops proportional to the declared span and allocate a table grid of the declared size. The result is CPU and memory exhaustion.

### Details

- `docling/backend/html_backend.py`

articles.title: GHSA: Next.js has cache poisoning of SSG and ISR pages in self-hosted applications
articles.summary: Self-hosted Next.js applications that use the Pages Router with statically generated (SSG) or incrementally regenerated (ISR) pages can have a page's cache entry replaced with content from a different route, causing the affected page to serve wrong content to every visitor until the entry is revalidated. articles.title: GHSA: Next.js has information disclosure in App Router metadata image routes via dynamicParams bypass
articles.summary: In Next.js App Router applications built with webpack, metadata image routes such as opengraph-image and twitter-image ignore the `dynamicParams` route segment option. articles.summary:
### Impact
A crafted request to the public first-register operation can be used to perform a RCE exploit.

**You are affected if:**

- You use local auth strategy and your application remains without an initial user created

In the patched version data submission to create first user is properly sanitized.

Users should upgrade Payload packages to `>= 3.90.0` or `>= 4.0.0-canary.34`.
